items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: I'd say, just Albert and him play... I could never catch up with him... I'd say, all right Bunnell... play high society for fate... I'd say, now, imitate Duke Ellington. He'd imitate Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: I don't know. Where is he at? So when Tab and them would come and play for us, well we'd all, you know, let them play. Instead of us playing. You see what I mean? He was on the boat then. He was on the boat playing with Fate and Marvel. And I had Bunnell playing piano with me. You see what I mean? So now and then we'd say, well, see Fate, he'd play high society for us. And Fate would play, you know, he's high society like he'd play. So when he'd get through playing I'd say, all right Bunnell. You know what I…
No, but I've heard about Lester told us a little bit.

Yes, indeed. He was the baddest piano player they had in the city in the Orleans. He was one of the best and couldn't really know. Fingers like Liv Rache. He could play just like Liv Rache in my book. You know what I mean? I'd say, just Albert and him play, I said, yeah I'm going to take me a little while Jack. Because I could never catch up with him. You know what I mean? His fingers was too fast. You understand? Because he'd play high society. Well he'd start to play in it. Then I'd say, all right, imitate Earl…
